recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Turkey Burgers
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Mix together turkey, spinach, feta, eggs, and garlic in a large bowl until well combined; form into 8 patties.

Cook patties on the preheated grill on both sides until no longer pink in the center, 15 to 20 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of patties should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Spinach and Feta Turkey Burgers
raw_recipe.description: These spinach and feta turkey burgers are moist and easy to make in one bowl with simple ingredients, shaped into patties, and cooked on a hot grill.

video.description: Elevate your backyard turkey burgers with this flavor-packed version, brimming with garlic, feta cheese and chopped spinach. Simply fire up your grill, combine all ingredients, and in 20 minutes you’ll have turkey burgers cooked perfectly and ready for your favorite toppings!

review.reviewBody: WOW. My husband asked for seconds! I used fresh spinach and cooked it in the oven because it wasn't grill weather. Turned out great!

Man cringed when I said I was making turkey-feta burgers... added some paprika, lemon juice, used egg whites, basil and additional garlic...absolutely FANTASTIC! My husband seriously couldn't stop eating or talking about how good they were! Thanks for the recipe -- will make this again and again!

Easy peasy, did not make patties, no eggs, added onions, garlic to pan first with sun dried tomato’s (Julianne cut) added the turkey mix & chopped as it cooked. I think the patties may have worked if I chilled them first. I lined pita pockets on the sides with tomatoes & cucumbers then loaded mix into the center, tzatziki sauce & a sprinkle of dill & we entered the world of YUM! Next day it was called Turkey Tzatziki Bowls with two quarters of a pita lining the bowel with tomatoes & sliced cucumbers. A wonderful recipe added to our weekly Summah menus!!! Thank you for sharing!!

Made as directed, it was tasty but too dense to my liking. Next time I cooked, I just beat egg whites till their foam held its shape and folded into meat, which greatly improved texture for me. Cooked with thermometer till ready. Adding feta to a burger was a brilliant idea that I have adapted for a meatloaf and sausage variations of this recipe. Having cooked this several times, I sometimes add a tsp of lime or lemon juice to brighten it up. Thank you for the idea.

these are simply scrumptious! Halved the recipe but with 4 oz. of feta. I did grate fresh onion, about 1/4 of an onion. Also added garlic powder, onion powder, dried oregano, 1 t. Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Put it all in the fridge for an hour and then fried them in olive oil. Full of flavor!!

I made this recently for dinner and it was a huge hit. Definitely a keeper. Instead of using the frozen spinach I sautéed fresh spinach in a skillet with olive oil, kosher salt, and fresh ground pepper. I let it cool completely then chopped it up before adding it to the meat mixture.

I fixed these burgers for dinner tonight and they were great. I bought 85/15 ground turkey and instead of plain feta, I used feta mixed with sun dried tomatoes and basil. Added all the other ingredients per the recipe. The raw mixture was pretty loose (maybe my spinach was too wet) so I pan fried the burgers. Next time I might use chopped raw spinach, or add some bread crumbs to absorb the excess moisture. used hearty rolls, topped the burgers with lettuce tomatoes and tzatziki sauce. Yummy. BTW, my guys who usually eat 2 burgers could only finish 1 of these. The recipe made 5.

Delicious burger! I used fresh spinach and chopped it finely. Also, I added one slice of whole wheat bread torn to the meat mixture to help hold it together. I also added some finely chopped onion to the mixture. Hubbs brushed some olive oil to both sides before putting on the grill. They were absolutely delicious and juicy. It was really nice with a dollup of taziki sauce on grilled whole wheat buns. GREAT recipe!
I added feta and frozen kale. Ah-ma-zing!!! Cooked the burgers on indoor grill doing quarter turns every three minutes four times (12minutes). Garnished with arugula and tomato slice.

I made this with fresh spinach, added sweet onion - sautéed the onion and garlic, added the spinach until wilted. Also put in a touch of lemon juice and a couple of shots of worcestershire sauce. Served it in a nan with alfalfa sprouts, chopped fresh tomatoes and of course, Taziki sauce. I did put them in freezer for about 30-40 mins before cooking on the grill. That helped a little but you definitely need to oil the grill before cooking. They were very tasty.

Delicious! I had fresh spinach so I used that sautéed with the garlic. I also chopped up some mini bell peppers and added to the sauté, then after cooled added to the other ingredients. I just pan fried them and they were delicious. Love these!!

I've made this twice now since finding the recipe and it's officially in my go-to list! It's so good! I found the original recipe lacked a little seasoning so I added in a pinch of salt, pepper (i measured by vibe), and some italian herbs. I think that helped a lot, but since i never made them "plain" i guess i can't /technically/ say for sure. I also add in diced onions for fun and that's a nice touch. I think on a grill these would be perfect, but alas i'm constrained to my stovetop. I find the feta that touches the pan tends to get a liiiiittle "Caramelized" (i probably burned it tbh) but it's not enough cheese being torched to change the taste or really matter. Anyway! Make'em! they're amazing! 4.5 stars!
Delicious flavor with the addition of Worcester, onion powder and Italian seasoning. Mixture was way too loose, even after adding breadcrumbs, they totally fell apart. I’ll need to tweak further.
Very delicious
Great recipe with two important notes: Removing water from spinach is VERY important, otherwise they are two soft and runny to form patties well. Definitely needs a dash of salt (or two).
I used fresh spinach,fresh garlic ,and onion. I also added paprika .
I am interested in making this. What is the bread?
They are excellent

Sooo good!!! I served mine on flat bread topped with carmelized red onion, bean sprouts, tomato, cucumber and homemade tzatziki. My kids were wary at first but they have all asked me to make it again next week!!

This is a great elevated summer burger! I followed other reviewers suggestions and added a sautéed chopped onion & garlic, splash of worcestershire sauce & tobasco. I used Trader Joes Mediterranean seasoned crumbled Feta for an extra boost of flavor. This recipe is a keeper! If you're on Weight Watchers the burgers are 6 points each.
